question: What textual source and chapter conclude the preceding mantra teachings?
premises: The passage concludes with a colophon.
The text is the Merutantra approved by Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla and composed by Śiva.
This is the twenty-second chapter named the narration of Bhairava and other mantras.
inference: The preceding teachings conclude the twenty-second chapter of the Merutantra on Bhairava and other mantras.
plain_english: Thus, in the Merutantra approved by Śrī Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla and composed by Śiva, ends the twenty-second chapter named the narration of Bhairava and other mantras.
